purpose: Decision-support knowledge base for showing the most relevant government agriculture scheme(s) after crop/disease assessment.
critical_rule: Disease prediction alone must never be treated as proof of scheme eligibility. Severe crop-health status can be used to prioritize loss-compensation/insurance pathways only when the official scheme conditions are also satisfied.

low.meaning: Disease detected but crop remains manageable; no evidence of major crop loss.
low.scheme_priority: Usually show no compensation scheme. Show preventive/input/development schemes only when their independent eligibility conditions match.

moderate.meaning: Disease is significant and may affect yield, but crop is not established as a qualifying total-loss event.
moderate.scheme_priority: Prioritize applicable crop-health/input/development support; do not present insurance compensation as guaranteed.

severe.meaning: Extensive damage or likely major loss; app should request/verify actual crop-loss facts rather than infer them solely from an image.
severe.scheme_priority: Prioritize crop-insurance/crop-loss compensation schemes when crop, state, season, notification, enrollment and loss conditions match.

critical.meaning: Crop is extensively damaged and may need removal/replanting, but an image model cannot legally establish scheme eligibility.
critical.scheme_priority: Show only schemes whose official conditions match the verified situation; compensation/insurance should be surfaced above general development schemes.

ranking_rules: 2. Match crop and notified crop/area where applicable.
3. Match the farmer's situation and scheme purpose.
4. If severe/critical loss is verified, rank applicable insurance/loss-compensation schemes first.
5. Never rank a scheme highly merely because its name contains the crop name.
6. Never claim guaranteed eligibility; show 'potentially relevant' until official verification.
7. Prefer current financial-year government orders/guidelines over older summaries.
8. Preserve official document and page references for every important eligibility/benefit rule.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.matching_note: Do not trigger from disease name alone. Verify current season/state/crop notification and policy conditions.

schemes.name: PM-KISAN
schemes.matching_note: General farmer income support; disease severity does not determine eligibility.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card
schemes.matching_note: Useful where crop damage creates a legitimate need for eligible agricultural credit; eligibility is determined by the lending institution and applicable guidelines.

schemes.name: Soil Health Card
schemes.matching_note: Not a disease-compensation scheme; useful where soil/nutrient management is relevant.

schemes.name: Per Drop More Crop
schemes.matching_note: Infrastructure/input support, not compensation for disease loss.

schemes.name: PM-Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (PM-RKVY)
schemes.matching_note: A broad umbrella/development framework; do not present it as direct disease compensation unless a specific approved component provides that support.

schemes.name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
schemes.matching_note: Useful for eligible horticulture development/replanting components where the current state implementation permits it.

schemes.name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
schemes.matching_note: Organic farming support; not an automatic disease-loss compensation mechanism.

schemes.name: National Mission on Natural Farming (NMNF)
schemes.matching_note: Practice-development support; not a direct disease-loss compensation scheme.

schemes.name: Kerala Restructured State Crop Insurance Scheme
schemes.special_rule: For crop pest/disease loss, the cited Kerala order specifically provides for paddy; do not generalize this disease-loss provision to all listed crops.
schemes.source_evidence: The 2025-26 Kerala circular states that compensation covers natural calamities/wild-animal menace for 27 major crops and pest/disease attack in rice; it also states partial damage is not considered and paddy compensation is provided when crop loss exceeds 50%. fileciteturn7file1L53-L74

implementation_note.recommended_app_output: Show at most 1-3 highest-ranked schemes, not the entire database.
implementation_note.severe_case: If verified severe/critical crop loss matches an insurance/compensation scheme, place that scheme first and explain the qualifying conditions.
implementation_note.non_severe_case: Do not show compensation as if it is available merely because a disease was detected; show relevant development/input schemes only if independent eligibility matches.
implementation_note.verification_message: Potentially relevant scheme. Final eligibility, notification, enrollment and claim approval must be confirmed through the official department/portal.
